Ashley (infra): ok team, starting the west3 cluster bring-up for customer-P this week. Need quota + capacity reservation plan. :wave:
Miguel: are we going A100s or A10G for this initial fleet? cost vs latency tradeoff?
Ashley (infra): prefer A100-40 if we can reserve, fallback A10G for burst. Primary goal: predictable throughput for 72h bootstrap.
Jia: I can file the quota request but need the justification, numbers, and preferred zones. Can someone drop expected sustained QPS and pkt size?
Miguel: estimate 120 inference qps sustained with peaks to 350qps, avg seq ~512 tokens. We'll need 40 GPUs reserved initially (spread across 2 zones).
Samir: confirm we want "capacity reservation" (not just quota) for first 72h to avoid preemptions during onboarding, yes?
Ashley (infra): yes. Reserve capacity (reservation id) for 72 hours, then convert to dedicated if customer converts. Also reserve IPs and subnet capacity.
sre-bot: Ticket created: Q-48219 - "west3 GPU reservation request". Assigned to: Miguel. ETA for review: 24h.
Miguel: filing now. Preferred zones: us-west3-b then us-west3-a. Instance family: nvidia-a100-40g. Requesting 40 GPUs (10 nodes x 4 GPUs) reservation. Cost center: PLG-onboard. Reason: initial customer P bring-up / perf validation.
Jia: procurement wants minimal config in ticket: exact machine type, GPU count, network egress estimate, expected start/end timestamps. Put the start as 2025-02-12T10:00Z end +72h.
Ashley (infra): added egress estimate: 2TB/day for logs + model pulls (safe upper). Also note we will run model pull once and then do blocked network tests.
Miguel: pasted gcloud CLI snippet in the ticket: ```
# check quotas
gcloud compute regions describe us-west3 --project=redwood-inference
# request quota
gcloud compute sole-tenancy reservations create west3-bootstrap --zone=us-west3-b --machine-type=n1-standard-32 --min-cpu-platform=Intel --local-ssd=1 --specific-resources=GPUS:NVIDIA_A100:10
```
Samir: for validation - plan: 1) infra smoke (nodes ready, drivers) 2) runtime smoke (nvidia-smi, cuda-dkms) 3) model smoke (serve a trimmed model, 10 qps) 4) perf sweep (seq 512 / 2048). If any step fails we rollback reservation and notify queue.
Jia: procurement asked for cost delta vs A10G for approval. Miguel can you add quick estimate?
Miguel: rough delta: A100 reserved ~ $1.8k/GPU-month equivalent pro-rated for 72h; A10G ~ $0.65k/GPU-month. For 40 GPUs for 72h delta ~ ~$18k vs ~$6.5k — i'll include exact numbers in ticket.
Ashley (infra): ops checklist for handoff to oncall (ops-squad):
- reservation id + ticket link
- zones allocated + ip ranges
- AMI/driver image sha + image location
- kube nodepool yaml used
- smoke test script and success criteria
- perf harness job ids
- rollback steps (how to release reservation)
Please confirm each is attached to ticket.
Miguel: attaching nodepool yaml and smoke scripts now. Also linking the internal runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/region-priming|region-priming runbook>
ops-squad: noted, we'll run the handoff checklist during the maintenance window and report back in this thread after perf sweep. :thumbsup:
Samir: quick verification commands we'll run once nodes are up: ``kubectl get nodes -l accelerator=nvidia-gpu -o wide`` then ``kubectl run driver-check --image=nvidia/cuda:11.7-base --restart=Never --rm -it -- nvidia-smi`` and the runtime smoke ``curl -X POST https://dev-west3-svc/redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":32}'``
Ashley (infra): one more ask - tag reservation ticket with "priority:onboard" and mark cost center so finance can pre-approve.
Miguel: done. Ticket Q-48219 now includes reservation snippet, cost estimate, justification, and runbook link. WG: please ack when you see green from cloud.
ops-squad: ack, standing by to run validation when cloud confirms reservation.
Jia: procurement responded: need small security note about KMS keys and whether private deployment uses customer KMS. I added question to the ticket.
Ashley (infra): thanks. If procurement delays >12h we switch to A10G fallback plan and continue with staging validation to avoid blocking customer onboarding.
Miguel: noted fallback plan and will update ticket to include fallback step: reserve 60 A10G preemptible-burst for immediate bootstrap.
ops-squad: i'll schedule perf window and reserve the validation job ids. Will post results here.
Ashley (infra): perfect — keep notes concise here. We'll close thread after handoff complete and attach final checklist to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
